subject.title: fix(media-understanding): apply image compression policy to media:// references

question: Which viable branch should become the single canonical repair for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101923 after the shared-resolver, HEIC-ordering, and source-cap fixes are applied?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102002 overlap substantially but take different implementation shapes; landing both would create competing fixes for one media-understanding contract.

options.title: Repair this narrower branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate only after replacing its local resolver and fixing the HEIC and byte-cap ordering defects.

options.title: Adopt the broader candidate
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102002 if its shared-resolver and cap-ordering approach is independently reviewed, rebased, and supplied with real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the issue canonical and request one fresh, narrow implementation if neither branch can be repaired cleanly.

recommendation.title: Repair this narrower branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical candidate only after replacing its local resolver and fixing the HEIC and byte-cap ordering defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on the shared model-aware compression contract introduced by the adaptive image-quality work.
